parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The identifier of the request source. Set the value to sas.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:

*   **app**: application vulnerability.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-domain-secure-vul-list --source-ip 111.196.0.0 --lang zh --from sas --type app --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeDomainSecureVulList --region cn-hangzhou --Type app --SourceIp '111.196.0.0' --Lang zh --From sas
